name: finds the source example words without mutating the board
input: four-by-four board with one missing word
test:
board = [['m', 'o', 'o', 'n'], ['s', 't', 'a', 'r'], ['p', 'l', 'a', 'n'], ['c', 'l', 'o', 'u']]
original = [row[:] for row in board]
result = Solution().findWords(board, ['moon', 'star', 'plan', 'clou', 'stone'])
assert set(result) == {'moon', 'star', 'plan', 'clou'}
assert len(result) == 4
assert board == original

name: rejects paths that would reuse a board cell
input: two-by-two board and a five-letter alternating word

name: shares trie prefixes while returning each found word once
test:
board = [['o', 'a', 'a', 'n'], ['e', 't', 'a', 'e'], ['i', 'h', 'k', 'r'], ['i', 'f', 'l', 'v']]
result = Solution().findWords(board, ['oath', 'pea', 'eat', 'rain'])
assert set(result) == {'oath', 'eat'}
assert len(result) == 2
